assumptions: Holocene = samples shallower than the 142 cm boundary; slice midpoints used (S07 at 137 cm is Holocene; S08 at 143 cm, slice 142.5-143.5 cm, lies wholly below the boundary).
issues: Mean over the 21 pairwise distances computed by the toolkit (community, braycurtis, no transform), averaged by me.
summary: Selected S01-S07 via palaeo study (select op), computed Bray-Curtis on raw counts with the toolkit (bundle study_holo), then averaged the 21 upper-triangle pairs.
